reviews.text:
I love everything about this shop!
The service is impeccable, fast, and personalized; the owner is friendly and always offers great advice; and on top of that, my dog ​​is crazy about their meatballs. We nicknamed him Mr. Meatball because he always patiently waits by the garage for his portion.
I highly recommend this place!

Fantastic experience every time. The food is a huge hit with my cats, and the convenience of delivery is hard to beat. David provides great customer service and clearly cares about both pets and their owners. Highly recommend!

I’ve been with Mrs. Meady’s for years, and my cats absolutely love their food. I’ve noticed a real difference in their health, energy, and overall well-being. The owner David is amazing, knowledgeable, kind, and truly cares about pets. Their delivery service is also reliable and convenient. Highly recommend Mrs. Meady’s!

Was  introduced to Mrs. Meady's by a friend. My 2 year old bombay Olive 🫒  loves all the varieties offered by David
She loves her food and I've noticed her is so silky and teeth are so white
Thsnk you Mrs Meady's …
Exceptional owner with passion and dedication to delivering only the highest quality! And my animals didn't hesitate a moment with the food - variety of meats (unlike with other raw brands I tried).

My beautiful puuper turned 9 years old last week and has eaten Mrs Meady since she was 3 months.  She is energetic and acts like a two year old and has the most amazing teeth.  Every time I go to the vet, he can't get over how good her teeth are.
We had a Rottweiler previously that did not eat raw frozen meat (because I hadn't yet studied proper dog nutrition) .  There is a vast difference between each pupper during different life stages.  I very highly recommend Mrs. Meady.

We’ve been very happy with Mrs Meadys dog food. Both of my dogs, Mini Long-Haired Dachshunds, are healthy, energetic, and genuinely excited for mealtimes every day. Their coats look great, digestion has been consistent, and they seem satisfied after eating. It’s reassuring to see them enjoy their food so much while also thriving overall. I appreciate the quality ingredients and the positive difference it’s made for their health and happiness.

On top of that, the customer service is top notch. Every interaction has been friendly, helpful, and responsive, which makes the
overall experience even better. It’s clear Dave truly cares about both pets and their owners.
Used to always shop for my dogs here! Love that they have so many different options even for dogs with allergies. Unfortunately I moved and are no stores close to me. Highly recommend

Just got my order — thank you again. I always tell everyone to get their dog food from you because it’s truly the best.

I’m probably the pickiest person on earth when it comes to my dogs. I’ve tried so many raw dog-food companies over the years, and I can’t even count how many times I had to return orders because of freezer burn, brown meat inside, or just plain gross quality. With you, I never have to worry about that. Ever. The consistency and freshness are always perfect.

The variety of meat you offer is amazing too. I actually just ordered the salmon ones for Deejay to try, and of course they’re incredible quality — he absolutely devours them.

I’m genuinely so happy with the quality of your food. It’s the best I’ve ever found, and Deejay never gets tired of it. He gets excited for every single meal.

Just wanted to say thank you and share how much I appreciate what you do.

Satisfies even the pickiest of kitties. I searched high and low for a raw food brand that both of my cats would eat, and Mrs. Meady's has been the big winner! Solid portions, well packed, and great options for in-store pickup if you want to save on shipping. Love the Intro Pack option so you can figure out what your cats like before spending more $. Big winners for these two were the Beef Supreme and Lamb & Liver varieties.

I rarely write reviews, but I have to say—I absolutely love Meady’s. It’s been a real struggle finding food for my Frenchie, Spooky, who has multiple allergies and digestive issues. Not only does Meady’s offer a great variety of options, but they also deliver through their own website and Uber Eats, which is so convenient.

Trust me, I’ve tried nearly every dog food option available in Montreal, and Meady’s has the best prices by far. Finding food that works for Spooky is already hard enough, so having high-quality raw food delivered right to my door is a total game-changer.

Thank you, Mrs. Meady’s—seriously!
Great owner, great products ! A must for any people looking to add raw to their animal diet !🐾 …

I've been feeding Mr meadys for more then a year to my Silken windhound Yuki. Before finding this store I was buying raw from the pet store. Let me tell you it does not compare in terms of quality. The pet store brands would be full of fat …

My dog ​​loves Mrs. Meadys' food. Every meal is a feast for my dog ​​Henry, and the service is excellent. Fast delivery and David, the owner, is always available. I highly recommend it; your dog will love it.
I have one picky dog but she loves her Mrs Meadys! Thank you David for your products and customer service.
